_metadata.description: Typed SRD 5.2.1 effect rules for spells whose saved effect records predate their typed modifier form (#1442): the modifiers a live record with no modifiers is given at load (or, for a spell whose typed form needs a choice the record never kept, that choice, reported), hand-authored and reviewed against the SRD text; verified-only
